text:
ash: quick ping — PR #1842 needs a tiny follow-up: format + a small rename in kvcache helper. CI fmt failed when merging. anyone able to take a quick fix & approve today?

maria: I can take it, will push a fix in ~30m.

ash: thanks @maria! CI showed these two errors: 
```
kvcache/cache.go:42: var name 'contextID' does not match project style (should be ctxID)
kvcache/store_test.go:13: file not gofmt'ed
```
so mainly `make fmt` and the var rename.

maria: copy — running `make fmt` now. plan: 
1) run formatter
2) rename `contextID` -> `ctxID` in kvcache package only
3) add one-line comment explaining abbreviation to avoid future churn

ci-bot: CI: formatting job FAILED for branch pr-1842 (fmt check). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/pr/1842/fmt

kevin: I can review after CI is green. @olivia fyi — are you ok with `ctxID` in this package? we prefer explicit names elsewhere but kvcache is internal.

olivia: prefer `requestID` at API boundaries, but `ctxID` is fine for internal cache. :+1:

maria: pushed branch `pr-1842-fmt-fix` with the changes. snippet: 
```diff
-    var contextID string
+    // ctxID holds the request-scoped id used by the kvcache layer
+    var ctxID string
```
Also ran `make fmt` and fixed two test files.

ci-bot: CI: formatting job PASSED for branch pr-1842-fmt-fix. build 3921 ✅

kevin: LGTM, thanks @maria. one tiny nit: maybe expand the comment to say "used for cache key derivation" — optional though.

maria: added the phrase and force-pushed. rebased on main.

dev-bot: Merge queued by @maria for pr-1842-fmt-fix — safe-merge checks: PASS

ash: awesome, thanks everyone. merged. :tada:
